topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: After install or upgrade I must be able to invoke itsm from the global PATH without hunting for a repo-local shim, and I must be able to choose or configure the install location.
Touch installer PATH registration and the published-kit bootstrap residual so .its-magic/bin/itsm actually materializes; keep Win and Linux parity (macOS in-scope if kit already claims Unix parity).

Do not reopen BUG-0025 ACs or US-0146/US-0147 DONE bodies; compose DEC-0120 omit-standalone and US-0147 repo-local itsm shim; PATH emptiness today is a consequence of bootstrap fail-closed, not a separate mystery.

Acceptance must prove opt-in global PATH registration with a user-chosen path, cross-platform Win/Linux coverage, and that published-kit install/upgrade materializes itsm enough for PATH to be meaningful.
Done when an operator can opt in to put itsm on PATH at a path they choose, it works on Linux and Windows, and published-kit bootstrap no longer leaves them without an itsm binary to register.
